title: Severe Hypoxemia with Tachycardia
description: SpO2 dropped below 89% for >45 seconds accompanied by acute heart rate elevation (128 bpm).

context.suspectedRootCause: Probable airway compromise or secretion accumulation post-extubation. Pleth wave shows good pulsatile amplitude (genuine physiological crisis, not artifact).
context.recommendedAction: 1. Immediate bedside assessment. 2. Verify oxygen delivery circuit and suction. 3. Prepare bag-valve-mask if desaturation persists.
context.multiParameterCorrelation: Concomitant tachycardia (128 bpm) confirms sympathetic response to hypoxemia. High confidence non-artifact.

title: Tachypnea with Borderline Desaturation
description: Respiratory rate elevated to 26 bpm with SpO2 drifting between 90-91%.

context.suspectedRootCause: Early respiratory muscle fatigue or patient-ventilator dyssynchrony.
context.recommendedAction: Check ventilator tubing condensation; assess breathing work and consider bronchodilator treatment.
context.multiParameterCorrelation: Heart rate stable at 92 bpm; no acute bradycardia. Moderate urgency.

title: ECG Lead V4 Signal Degradation
description: High electrode impedance detected on precordial Lead V4. Baseline wander detected without arrhythmia.

context.suspectedRootCause: Electrode gel dry-out or partial detachment caused by patient repositioning in bed.
context.recommendedAction: Re-prep skin and replace V4 disposable electrode during next routine nursing round. Audio alarm suppressed to reduce fatigue.
context.multiParameterCorrelation: Heart rate derived from arterial line and pulse oximeter remains rock solid at 64 bpm with normal rhythm. No patient distress.

title: NIBP Cuff Inflation Timeout
description: Scheduled non-invasive blood pressure measurement timed out due to patient movement.

context.suspectedRootCause: Patient was drinking water when cuff inflated. Art-line continuous MAP is normal (82 mmHg).
context.recommendedAction: Re-run NIBP manually when patient is resting still.
context.multiParameterCorrelation: Invasive arterial line transducer reading is normal and steady.

history.note: Patient checked; art line active and normal.

title: Infusion Syringe Volume Near Empty (<10%)
description: Syringe pump 02 (Furosemide infusion) has approximately 15 minutes remaining volume.

context.recommendedAction: Prepare replacement syringe according to MAR protocol.

history.note: New syringe mounted and primed. Flow re-established.
